native_decision.reason: The donor provides concrete literal Clojure declaration shapes: project.clj contains a defproject form whose :profiles/:dev map has literal :dependencies and :plugins vectors, including a dependency with a literal :scope option; deps.edn is an empty literal map. The receiving inventory has no Clojure manifest classification, its dependency miner excludes a Clojure ecosystem, and parse_manifest has no corresponding dispatch. This is an additive design gap rather than a runtime-defect claim.
native_decision.adaptation: Add receiving-original recognition for project.clj and deps.edn and a data-only parser that never evaluates or resolves Clojure. Accept only an explicitly documented literal subset: for project.clj, a single top-level defproject with literal maps and dependency/plugin vectors; for deps.edn, a literal top-level map with supported dependency maps. Emit Package facts with the exact manifest path, declared coordinate and literal version/spec, plus declaration context such as profile and dependency-versus-plugin kind. Treat reader evaluation, symbols used as computed values, metadata or tagged forms outside the subset, interpolation, arbitrary calls, malformed structures, and excess resource limits as unsupported evidence with structured warnings rather than inferred dependencies.

Maintain fixtures for each accepted literal form and each rejected dynamic form, and preserve manifest/profile provenance and deterministic ordering in output and warnings.

native_decision.reason: The receiving iterator currently emits only (line, destination), reference uses also discard match columns, and check_repo consumes that pair to produce line-only errors. native_decision.adaptation: Add an opt-in location-rich iterator or structured diagnostic record carrying destination plus a documented source-character line/column anchor. Compute the anchor from the original source position retained by each inline or reference-use match, not from decoded destination length. native_decision.maintenance: Use one internal location representation and derive the legacy iterator and optional structured diagnostics from it so parsing rules cannot drift.
